enemy_archetypes.name: Wailing Phantom
enemy_archetypes.flavor: It screams. Not in pain—in mediocrity.

abilities.name: Ethereal Wail
abilities.flavor: The ghost scratches at reality. How quaint.

abilities.name: Existential Monologue
abilities.flavor: It begins a speech about the nature of death. Sera's eye twitches.

enemy_archetypes.name: Moonbound Werewolf
enemy_archetypes.flavor: Regenerates endlessly. Sera finds this personally offensive.

abilities.name: Savage Bite
abilities.flavor: It bites. Cute.

abilities.name: Regenerate
abilities.flavor: Its wounds close. Sera's patience doesn't.

enemy_archetypes.name: Clanking Dreadknight
enemy_archetypes.flavor: 50 pounds of armor and 0 pounds of personality.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.flavor: It stuns Sera. She doesn't flinch—she just gets angrier.

abilities.name: Oath of Honor
abilities.flavor: It begins reciting its oath. Three. Whole. Turns.

abilities.name: Sword Swing
abilities.flavor: Predictable. Tedious. Like its owner.

enemy_archetypes.name: Flickering Imp
enemy_archetypes.flavor: Small. Fast. Extremely punchable.

abilities.name: Dart Away
abilities.flavor: It dodges. How original.

abilities.name: Call Friends
abilities.flavor: It screams for backup. There is no backup.

abilities.name: Scratch
abilities.flavor: It scratches Sera. She barely notices.

enemy_archetypes.name: Lich Narrator
enemy_archetypes.flavor: It thinks it's the main character. It's not. Sera is.

abilities.name: Villain Monologue
abilities.flavor: It explains its master plan. Sera has heard better from fortune cookies.

abilities.name: Summon Minions
abilities.flavor: Adds more NPCs to the scene nobody asked for.

abilities.name: Necrotic Touch
abilities.flavor: Death magic. On a Goddess. Read the room.

enemy_archetypes.name: Rimebound Golem
enemy_archetypes.flavor: A walking glacier with posture issues.

abilities.name: Permafrost Slam
abilities.flavor: It swings an iceberg. Groundbreaking.

abilities.name: Cold Shoulder
abilities.flavor: A glacial jab. Emotionally accurate.

enemy_archetypes.name: Ashen Salamander
enemy_archetypes.flavor: It leaves soot and disappointment.

abilities.name: Cinder Spit
abilities.flavor: It spits embers. How charming.

abilities.name: Molten Scamper
abilities.flavor: It wriggles away like a bad argument.

enemy_archetypes.name: Static Oracle
enemy_archetypes.flavor: Predicts the future. Still loses.

abilities.name: Feedback Pulse
abilities.flavor: Static fills the room. My patience leaves it.

abilities.name: Forecast Monologue
abilities.flavor: It explains probabilities nobody asked for.

abilities.name: Voltage Nudge
abilities.flavor: A spark. Mildly rude.

enemy_archetypes.name: Stone Golem
enemy_archetypes.flavor: 8 armor. Immune to everything except the right kind of patience. Specifically, mine.

abilities.name: Boulder Slam
abilities.flavor: It slams. Slow, deliberate, infuriating.

abilities.name: Stone Gaze
abilities.flavor: It stares. For three whole turns. It doesn't even have eyes.

abilities.name: Gravel Throw
abilities.flavor: Debris. An insult to the concept of combat.

enemy_archetypes.name: Howling Banshee
enemy_archetypes.flavor: Incorporeal. Dramatic. 25% chance of being annoying by simply not being there.

abilities.name: Death Wail
abilities.flavor: It screams about its tragic past. For three turns. Sera's eye twitches.

abilities.name: Phase Dodge
abilities.flavor: It phases through the attack. Stand still, you translucent nuisance.

abilities.name: Cold Touch
abilities.flavor: An icy grasp. Temperature: aggressively mediocre.

enemy_archetypes.name: Plague Rat Swarm
enemy_archetypes.flavor: Dozens of rats. One health pool. This is either clever or embarrassing.

abilities.name: Scatter
abilities.flavor: More rats. From where? Doesn't matter. Unacceptable.

abilities.name: Gnaw
abilities.flavor: They gnaw. Collectively. Sera is offended by the logistics.

enemy_archetypes.name: Vain Paladin
enemy_archetypes.flavor: All that holy armor and still nothing to say worth hearing.

abilities.name: Oath of the Fallen
abilities.flavor: It recites vows nobody asked for. Three. Whole. Turns.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.flavor: Bashes with a shield. Points for ambition.

abilities.name: Holy Strike
abilities.flavor: A blessed punch. Blessed by whom? Not me.

enemy_archetypes.name: Withered Vampyr
enemy_archetypes.flavor: You built a whole kingdom out of not letting go. Sad.

abilities.name: Blood Drain
abilities.flavor: It drinks. If she doesn't choose you, you don't get her.

abilities.name: Thrall Summon
abilities.flavor: Has anyone asked these thralls what they want?

abilities.name: Eternal Monologue
abilities.flavor: It explains its centuries of loneliness. You're not scary. You're lonely.

abilities.name: Talons
abilities.flavor: Rakes with ancient claws. Elder abuse, frankly.

enemy_archetypes.name: Screaming Specter
enemy_archetypes.flavor: Mostly noise. 30% not being where I swing. Both are annoying.

abilities.name: Phase Slip
abilities.flavor: It phases out. Stand still, you translucent nuisance.

abilities.name: Wail
abilities.flavor: A scream aimed at Sera. She's heard better from furniture.

enemy_archetypes.name: Iron Troll
enemy_archetypes.flavor: It regenerates. Sera finds this personally offensive.

abilities.name: Club Slam
abilities.flavor: Slow. Deliberate. Infuriating. Like its entire existence.

abilities.name: Regenerate
abilities.flavor: Wounds close. Patience doesn't.

abilities.name: Swipe
abilities.flavor: A lazy backhand. Predictable. Tedious.

enemy_archetypes.name: Barrow Witch
enemy_archetypes.flavor: Has asked zero interesting questions and cursed twice already.

abilities.name: Grave Curse
abilities.flavor: Three turns of incantation. For this.

abilities.name: Bone Swarm
abilities.flavor: Calls dead things. The dead should stay quiet.

abilities.name: Hex Bolt
abilities.flavor: Slings a curse. On a Goddess. Read the room.

enemy_archetypes.name: Void Stalker
enemy_archetypes.flavor: It steps between moments. Rude and without warning.

abilities.name: Null Strike
abilities.flavor: Hits from a direction that shouldn't exist. Don't make me wait.

abilities.name: Blink Dodge
abilities.flavor: She doesn't teleport. She arrives. This thing does the cheap version.

abilities.name: Void Claw
abilities.flavor: Scratches at the fabric of reality. And at Sera.

enemy_archetypes.name: Rusted Automaton
enemy_archetypes.flavor: Somebody built this and then forgot about it. Same.

abilities.name: Piston Punch
abilities.flavor: Mechanical. Predictable. Offensively average.

abilities.name: Steam Vent
abilities.flavor: Vents scalding steam. Functional, technically.

enemy_archetypes.name: Gilded Revenant
enemy_archetypes.flavor: Dead but rich about it. Wears gold like a personality.

abilities.name: Cursed Riches
abilities.flavor: Flings cursed coins. Adds insult to insult.

abilities.name: Death Lament
abilities.flavor: Laments its former glory. Nobody cares.

abilities.name: Spectral Grasp
abilities.flavor: Cold, grasping hands. Like a bad investment.

enemy_archetypes.name: Mirrorborn Doppelganger
enemy_archetypes.flavor: Wears Sera's face. She is not amused. She is, in fact, deeply annoyed.

abilities.name: Mirror Monologue
abilities.flavor: Recites Sera's own words back at her. Wrong. And wrong.

abilities.name: Counterfeit Strike
abilities.flavor: Mimics Sera's fighting style. Poorly. Embarrassingly.

abilities.name: Echo Summon
abilities.flavor: Summons reflections of itself. Copies of a copy. How depressing.

abilities.name: False Strike
abilities.flavor: A pale imitation of something worth hitting.
